panes.label: CAD
panes.description: Model solids, spaces and building elements side by side in coordinated CAD windows.

panes.label: Procedural 3D
panes.description: Build parametric 3D geometry from flows of operations and preview every step live.

panes.label: Procedural 2D
panes.description: Compose parametric 2D profiles from flows of operations and inspect the result.

panes.label: Flow
panes.description: Wire nodes into dataflow graphs that compute values, geometry and building data.

panes.label: Low Poly
panes.description: Shape faceted meshes vertex by vertex and review them in a live 3D view.

panes.label: Remodel
panes.description: Reconstruct surfaces from camera captures and compare the model against the scan.

panes.label: Draw
panes.description: Sketch vector drawings with pens, shapes and layers and export them as documents.

panes.label: Raster
panes.description: Paint and edit raster images with brushes, fills and layers.

panes.label: Layout
panes.description: Arrange text, images and frames into page layouts.

panes.label: Shooting
panes.description: Place cameras and lights in a scene and frame the shots you want to render.

panes.label: Puzzle 2D
panes.description: Assemble designs from components connected by ports on a 2D board.

panes.label: Puzzle 3D
panes.description: Assemble designs from components in 3D, suggest matching parts and fill structures automatically.

panes.label: Puzzle 5D
panes.description: Explore assemblies across time and design alternatives in one spatial view.

panes.label: Block 2D
panes.description: Lay out block-based designs on a 2D grid.

panes.label: Block 3D
panes.description: Stack blocks into volumetric designs and inspect them in 3D.

panes.label: Block 5D
panes.description: Follow block designs through time and alternatives.

panes.label: WFC 2D
panes.description: Generate 2D patterns from tile rules with wave function collapse.

panes.label: WFC 3D
panes.description: Generate 3D structures from module rules with wave function collapse.

panes.label: Grid 2D
panes.description: Paint and constrain 2D tile grids that feed the generators.

panes.label: Grid 3D
panes.description: Place and constrain modules in 3D grids that feed the generators.

panes.label: Bitmap
panes.description: Generate new images that follow the local patterns of a sample bitmap.

panes.label: FEM 2D
panes.description: Model plane frames with nodes, supports and loads and read the structural response.

panes.label: FEM 3D
panes.description: Model spatial frames, solve them and inspect deformations and internal forces.

panes.label: Energy
panes.description: Model zones, envelopes and boundary conditions and simulate the thermal behaviour of a building.

panes.label: Process 3D
panes.description: Plan the machining and fabrication steps for a workpiece and preview them in 3D.

panes.label: Sourcing
panes.description: Browse a pool of available components, filter it and curate a selection for a project.

panes.label: Map
panes.description: Explore locations and their relations on an interactive 2D map.

panes.label: Terrain
panes.description: Fly over elevation data and inspect sites on a 3D terrain.

panes.label: DIN EN 16798

panes.label: DIN V 18599
panes.description: Assess the overall energy efficiency of buildings.

panes.label: Eurocode 3

panes.label: Eurocode 4

panes.label: Eurocode 5
panes.description: Design timber members and connections.

panes.label: Eurocode 6
panes.description: Design masonry walls and members.

panes.label: Eurocode 7
panes.description: Verify foundations, retaining structures and ground.

panes.label: Eurocode 8
panes.description: Design structures for earthquake resistance.

panes.label: Eurocode 9

panes.label: ISO 16757
panes.description: Describe building services products with standardised data structures.

panes.label: VDI 3805

panes.label: Writer

panes.label: Forms

panes.description: Write and evaluate mathematical equations.

panes.label: Wires
panes.description: Connect ideas into mind maps and follow the wires between them.

panes.label: Playbook

panes.description: Arrange clips and events into sequences.
